functions.name: CalcView
functions.description:
Optionally alter the player's view if they are using this <page>drive</page> mode.

This hook is called from the default implementation of <page>GM:CalcView</page> which is [here](https://github.com/Facepunch/garrysmod/blob/master/garrysmod/gamemodes/base/gamemode/cl_init.lua#L387-L395). Therefore, it will not be called if any other hook added to `CalcView` returns any value, or if the current gamemode overrides the default hook and does not call <page>drive.CalcView</page>.

arguments.name: view_in
arguments.description: The view, see <page>Structures/CamData</page>. Modify this table.

functions.name: EndTouch
functions.description: Effect alternative to <page>ENTITY:EndTouch</page>.

functions.name: GetTracerShootPos
functions.description:
Used to get the "real" start position of a trace, for weapon tracer effects.

"real" meaning in 3rd person, the 3rd person position will be used, in first person the first person position will be used.

arguments.name: pos
arguments.description: Default position if we fail

arguments.name: ent
arguments.description: The weapon to use.

arguments.name: attachment
arguments.description:
Attachment ID of on the weapon "muzzle", to use as the start position.

<note>Please note that it is expected that the same attachment ID is used on both, the world and the view model.</note>

returnValues.description: The "real" start position.

functions.name: Init
functions.description: Called when the effect is created.

arguments.name: effectData
arguments.description: The effect data used to create the effect.

functions.name: PhysicsCollide
functions.description: Called when the effect collides with anything.

arguments.name: colData
arguments.description: Information regarding the collision. See <page>Structures/CollisionData</page>

arguments.name: collider
arguments.description: The physics object of the entity that collided with the effect.

functions.name: Render
functions.description:
Called when the effect should be rendered.

When not overridden, it will perform default action, which is <page>Entity:DrawModel</page>.

functions.name: StartTouch
functions.description: Effect alternative to <page>ENTITY:StartTouch</page>.

functions.name: Think
functions.description: Called when the effect should think, return false to kill the effect.

returnValues.description: Return false to remove this effect.

functions.name: Touch
functions.description: Effect alternative to <page>ENTITY:Touch</page>.

functions.name: AcceptInput
functions.description: Called when another entity fires an event to this entity.

arguments.name: inputName
arguments.description: The name of the input that was triggered.

arguments.name: activator
arguments.description: The initial cause for the input getting triggered. (e.g. the player who pushed a button)

arguments.name: caller
arguments.description: The entity that directly triggered the input. (e.g. the button that was pushed)

arguments.name: param
arguments.description: The input parameter.

returnValues.description:
Should we suppress the default action for this input?

Returning `true` for unknown inputs will also prevent the game complaining about the unknown input in console with `developer 2`.

functions.name: AddOutputFromAcceptInput
functions.description:
A helper function for creating <page>Scripted Entities</page>.

Similar to <page>ENTITY:AddOutputFromKeyValue</page>, call it from <page>ENTITY:AcceptInput</page> and it'll return true if it successfully added an output from the passed input data.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: The input name from <page>ENTITY:AcceptInput</page>.

arguments.name: data
arguments.description: The input data from <page>ENTITY:AcceptInput</page>.

returnValues.description: Whether any outputs were added or not.

functions.name: AddOutputFromKeyValue
functions.description:
A helper function for creating <page>Scripted Entities</page>.

Call it from <page>ENTITY:KeyValue</page> and it'll return true if it successfully added an output from the passed KV pair.

arguments.name: key
arguments.description: The key-value key.

arguments.name: value
arguments.description: The key-value value.

returnValues.description: Whether any outputs were added or not.

functions.name: CalcAbsolutePosition
functions.description:
Called whenever the entity's position changes. A callback for when an entity's angle changes is available via <page>Entity:AddCallback</page>.

Like <page>ENTITY:RenderOverride</page>, this hook works on any entity (scripted or not) it is applied on.

<warning>Defining or clearing this function in the entity table will not do anything, you must define this method in the entity itself</warning>
<note>If EFL_DIRTY_ABSTRANSFORM is set on the entity, this will be called serverside only; otherwise, this will be called clientside only. This means serverside calls of <page>Entity:SetPos</page> without the EFL_DIRTY_ABSTRANSFORM flag enabled (most cases) will be called clientside only.</note>

<note>The give concommand will call this hook serverside only upon entity spawn.</note>

arguments.name: pos
arguments.description: The entity's actual position. May differ from <page>Entity:GetPos</page>

arguments.name: ang
arguments.description: The entity's actual angles. May differ from <page>Entity:GetAngles</page>

returnValues.description: New position
New angles

functions.name: CanEditVariables
functions.description: Called by the Sandbox gamemode from the default implementation of <page>GM:CanEditVariable</page>.

arguments.name: ply
arguments.description: The player is trying to edit a variable on this entity.

returnValues.description: `true` to allow the edit, `false` to disallow.

functions.name: CanProperty
functions.description:
Controls if a property can be used on this entity or not.

This hook will only work in Sandbox derived gamemodes that do not have <page>GM:CanProperty</page> overridden.

<note>This hook will work on ALL entities, not just the scripted ones (SENTs)</note>

arguments.name: ply
arguments.description: Player, that tried to use the property

arguments.name: property
arguments.description: Class of the property that is tried to use, for example - bonemanipulate

returnValues.description:
Return false to disallow using that property, return true to allow.

You must return a value. Not returning anything can cause unexpected results.

functions.name: CanTool
functions.description:
Controls if a tool can be used on this entity or not.

This hook will only work in Sandbox derived gamemodes that do not have <page>SANDBOX:CanTool</page> overridden.

<note>This hook will work on ALL entities, not just the scripted ones (SENTs)</note>

arguments.name: ply
arguments.description: Player, that tried to use the tool

arguments.name: tr
arguments.description:
The trace of the tool.
<warning>Returns only the <page text="world">game.GetWorld</page> in the <page text="Entity">Structures/TraceResult#Entity</page> key and returns false in the <page text="Hit">Structures/TraceResult#Hit</page> key when the 5th argument returns `4`.</warning>

arguments.name: toolname
arguments.description: Class of the tool that is tried to use, for example - `weld`

arguments.name: tool
arguments.description: The tool mode table the player currently has selected.

arguments.name: button
arguments.description:
The tool button pressed.
* `1` - left click
* `2` - right click
* `3` - reload
* `4` - spawn menu (No interaction with the toolgun). **Client-side only**

returnValues.description: Return `false` to disallow using that tool on this entity, return `true` to allow.

functions.name: CreateSchedulesInternal
functions.description: <internal></internal>Called just before <page>ENTITY:Initialize</page> for "ai" type entities only.

functions.name: DoImpactEffect
functions.description:
Called so the entity can override the bullet impact effects it makes. This is called when the entity itself fires bullets via <page>Entity:FireBullets</page>, not when it gets hit.

<note>This hook only works for the `anim` type entities.</note>

arguments.name: tr
arguments.description: A <page>Structures/TraceResult</page> from the bullet's start point to the impact point

arguments.name: damageType
arguments.description: The damage type of bullet. See <page>Enums/DMG</page>

returnValues.description: Return true to not do the default thing - which is to call `UTIL_ImpactTrace` in C++

functions.name: DoingEngineSchedule
functions.description:
Called by the default `base_ai` SNPC, checking whether `ENT.bDoingEngineSchedule` is set by <page>ENTITY:StartEngineSchedule</page>..
<note>This is a helper function only available if your SENT is based on `base_ai`</note>

functions.name: DoSchedule
functions.description:
Runs a Lua schedule. Runs tasks inside the schedule.
<note>This is a helper function only available if your SENT is based on `base_ai`</note>

arguments.name: sched
arguments.description: The schedule to run.

functions.name: Draw
functions.description:
Called if and when the entity should be drawn opaquely, based on the <page>Entity:GetRenderGroup</page> of the entity.

See <page>Structures/ENT</page> and <page>Enums/RENDERGROUP</page> for more information.

See also <page>ENTITY:DrawTranslucent</page>.

<note>This function will not called if the entity's render bounds are not in player's view. See <page>Entity:SetRenderBounds</page>.</note>

arguments.name: flags
arguments.description: The bit flags from <page>Enums/STUDIO</page>

functions.name: DrawTranslucent
functions.description:
Called when the entity should be drawn translucently. If your scripted entity has a translucent model, it will be invisible unless it is drawn here.

See <page>ENTITY:Draw</page> for the opaque rendering alternative to this hook.

arguments.name: flags
arguments.description: The bit flags from <page>Enums/STUDIO</page>

functions.name: EndTouch
functions.description:
Called when the entity stops touching another entity.

See <page>ENTITY:StartTouch</page> and <page>ENTITY:Touch</page> for related hooks.

<warning>This only works for **brush** entities and for entities that have <page>Entity:SetTrigger</page> set to true.</warning>

arguments.name: entity
arguments.description: The entity that we no longer touch.

functions.name: EngineScheduleFinish
functions.description:
Called whenever an engine schedule is finished; either the last task within the engine schedule has been finished or the schedule has been interrupted by an interrupt condition.
<note>This hook only exists for `ai` type [SENTs](Scripted_Entities).</note>
<note>This hook isn't called when the engine schedule is failed, the schedule is cleared with <page>NPC:ClearSchedule</page> or <page>NPC:SetSchedule</page> has been called. </note>

functions.name: ExpressionFinished
functions.description:
Called when an NPC's expression has finished.
<note>This hook only exists for `ai` type [SENTs](Scripted_Entities).</note>

arguments.name: strExp
arguments.description: The path of the expression.

functions.name: FireAnimationEvent
functions.description:
Called before firing clientside animation events, such as muzzle flashes or shell ejections.

See <page>ENTITY:HandleAnimEvent</page> for the serverside version.

<note>This hook only works on "anim", "nextbot" and "ai" type entities.</note>

arguments.name: pos
arguments.description: Position of the effect

arguments.name: ang
arguments.description: Angle of the effect

arguments.name: event
arguments.description: The event ID of happened even. See [this page](http://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Animation_Events). Only event IDs above 5000 will appear in this hook. (Are considered the "new" system in-engine)

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: Name of the event

returnValues.description: Return true to disable the effect

functions.name: GetAttackSpread
functions.description:
Called to determine how good an NPC is at using a particular weapon.

<note>"ai" base only</note>

arguments.name: wep
arguments.description: The weapon being used by the NPC.

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: The target the NPC is attacking

returnValues.description: The number of degrees of inaccuracy in the NPC's attack.

functions.name: GetRelationship
functions.description:
Called when scripted NPC needs to check how it "feels" against another entity, such as when <page>NPC:Disposition</page> is called.

<note>Scripted NPCs will not select other entities using same <page>Entity:GetModel</page> as this Scripted NPC's <page>Entity:GetModel</page> as enemy, unless <page>NPC:AddEntityRelationship</page> is cast.</note>

arguments.name: ent
arguments.description: The entity in question

returnValues.description: How our scripted NPC "feels" towards the entity in question. See <page>Enums/D</page>. Not returning any value will make <page>NPC:Disposition</page> return the default disposition for this SNPC's given `m_iClass` by the engine.

functions.name: GetRenderMesh
functions.description:
Specify a mesh that should be rendered instead of this SENT's model.
<note>You should not be creating or modifying an <page>IMesh</page> in this hook. [Reference](https://github.com/Facepunch/garrysmod-issues/issues/6411#issuecomment-3070608549)</note>

returnValues.description:
A table containing the following keys:
* <page>IMesh</page> Mesh - (Required) The mesh to render instead of the default model
* <page>IMaterial</page> Material - (Required) The material to render the mesh with.
* <page>VMatrix</page> Matrix - (Optional) - Render matrix override (mesh position, angles, etc)

functions.name: GetShadowCastDirection
functions.description: Called when the shadow needs to be recomputed. Allows shadow angles to be customized. This only works for `anim` type entities.

arguments.name: type
arguments.description:
Type of the shadow this entity uses. Possible values:
* 0 - No shadow
* 1 - Simple 'blob' shadow
* 2 - Render To Texture shadow (updates only when necessary)
* 3 - Dynamic RTT - updates always
* 4 - Render to Depth Texture

returnValues.name: dir
returnValues.description: The new shadow direction to use.

functions.name: GetSoundInterests
functions.description:
Called every second to poll the sound hint interests of this SNPC. This is used in conjunction with other sound hint functions, such as <page>sound.EmitHint</page> and <page>NPC:GetBestSoundHint</page>.
<note>This hook only exists for `ai` type SENTs</note>

returnValues.name: types
returnValues.description: A bitflag representing which sound types this NPC wants to react to.  See <page text="SOUND_ enums">Enums/SOUND</page>.

functions.name: GravGunPickupAllowed
functions.description: Called by <page>GM:GravGunPickupAllowed</page> on ALL entites in Sandbox-derived  gamemodes and acts as an override.

arguments.name: ply
arguments.description: The player aiming at us

returnValues.description: Return true to allow the entity to be picked up

functions.name: GravGunPunt
functions.description:
Called when this entity is about to be punted with the gravity gun (primary fire).

Only works in Sandbox derived gamemodes and only if <page>GM:GravGunPunt</page> is not overridden.

arguments.name: ply
arguments.description: The player pressing left-click with the gravity gun at an entity

returnValues.description: Return true or false to enable or disable punting respectively.

functions.name: HandleAnimEvent
functions.description:
Called before firing serverside animation events, such as weapon reload, drawing and holstering for NPCs, scripted sequences, etc.

See <page>ENTITY:FireAnimationEvent</page> for the clientside version.

<note>This hook only works on "anim", "ai" and "nextbot" type entities.</note>

arguments.name: event
arguments.description: The ID of the event. See [this page](http://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Animation_Events) for a list of default events, and see <page>util.GetAnimEventNameByID</page> for a helper function in handing custom events.

arguments.name: eventTime
arguments.description: The absolute time this event occurred using <page>Global.CurTime</page>.

arguments.name: cycle
arguments.description: The frame this event occurred as a number between 0 and 1.

arguments.name: type
arguments.description: Event type. See [the Source SDK](https://github.com/ValveSoftware/source-sdk-2013/blob/master/src/game/shared/eventlist.h#L14-L23).

arguments.name: options
arguments.description: Name or options of this event.

returnValues.description: Return true to mark the event as handled.

functions.name: ImpactTrace
functions.description: Called when a bullet trace hits this entity and allows you to override the default behavior by returning true.

arguments.name: traceResult
arguments.description: The trace that hit this entity as a <page>Structures/TraceResult</page>.

arguments.name: damageType
arguments.description: The damage bits associated with the trace, see <page>Enums/DMG</page>

arguments.name: customImpactName
arguments.description:
The effect name to override the impact effect with.
Possible arguments are ImpactJeep, AirboatGunImpact, HelicopterImpact, ImpactGunship.

returnValues.description: Return true to override the default impact effects.

functions.name: Initialize
functions.description:
Called when the entity is created. This is called when you <page>Entity:Spawn</page> the custom entity.

This is called **after** <page>ENTITY:SetupDataTables</page> and <page>GM:OnEntityCreated</page>.

functions.name: IsJumpLegal
functions.description:
Called when deciding if the Scripted NPC should be able to perform a certain jump or not.
<note>This is only called for "ai" type entities</note>

arguments.name: startPos
arguments.description: Start of the jump

arguments.name: apex
arguments.description: Apex point of the jump

arguments.name: endPos
arguments.description: The landing position

returnValues.description:
Return true if this jump should be allowed to be performed, false otherwise.

Not returning anything, or returning a non boolean will perform the [default action](https://github.com/ValveSoftware/source-sdk-2013/blob/master/src/game/server/ai_basenpc_movement.cpp#L319).

functions.name: KeyValue
functions.description:
Called when the engine sets a value for this scripted entity. This hook is called **before** ENTITY:Initialize when the key-values are set by the map.
Otherwise this hook will be called whenever Entity:SetKeyValue is called on the entity. See GM:EntityKeyValue for a hook that works for all entities. See WEAPON:KeyValue for a hook that works for scripted weapons.

arguments.name: key
arguments.description: The key that was affected.

arguments.name: value
arguments.description: The new value.

returnValues.description: Return true to suppress this KeyValue or return false or nothing to apply this key value.

functions.name: NextTask
functions.description:
Start the next task in specific Lua schedule.
<note>This is a helper function only available if your SENT is based on `base_ai`</note>

arguments.name: sched
arguments.description: The schedule to start next task in.

functions.name: OnChangeActiveWeapon
functions.description:
Called when the currently active weapon of the SNPC changes.
<note>This hook only works on `ai` type entities.</note>

arguments.name: old
arguments.description: The previous active weapon.

arguments.name: new
arguments.description: The new active weapon.

functions.name: OnChangeActivity
functions.description:
Called when the NPC has changed its activity.

<note>This hook only works for `ai` type entities.</note>

arguments.name: act
arguments.description: The new activity. See <page>Enums/ACT</page>.

functions.name: OnCondition
functions.description:
Called each time the NPC updates its condition.
<note>This hook only exists for `ai` type [SENTs](Scripted_Entities).</note>

arguments.name: conditionID
arguments.description: The ID of condition. See <page>NPC:ConditionName</page>.

functions.name: OnDuplicated
functions.description:
Called on any entity after it has been created by the <page>duplicator</page> and before any bone/entity modifiers have been applied.

This hook is called after <page>ENTITY:Initialize</page> and before <page>ENTITY:PostEntityPaste</page>.

arguments.name: entTable
arguments.description: The stored data about the original entity that was duplicated. This would typically contain the <page>Entity:GetTable</page> fields that are serializable. See <page>Structures/EntityCopyData</page>.

functions.name: OnEntityCopyTableFinish
functions.description:
Called after duplicator finishes saving the entity, allowing you to modify the save data.

This is called after <page>ENTITY:PostEntityCopy</page>.

arguments.name: data
arguments.description: The save <page>Structures/EntityCopyData</page> that you can modify.

functions.name: OnMovementComplete
functions.description:
Called when the SNPC completes its movement to its destination.
<note>This hook only works on `ai` type entities.</note>

functions.name: OnMovementFailed
functions.description:
Called when the SNPC failed to move to its destination.
<note>This hook only works on `ai` type entities.</note>

functions.name: OnReloaded
functions.description: Called when the entity is reloaded by the lua auto-refresh system, i.e. when the developer edits the lua file for the entity while the game is running.

functions.name: OnRemove
functions.description: Called when the entity is about to be removed. See also Entity:CallOnRemove, which can even be used on engine (non-Lua) entities. Create an explosion when the entity will be removed. To create an entity, you can read ents.Create. function ENT:OnRemove() local explosion = ents.Create( "env_explosion" ) -- The explosion entity explosion:SetPos( self:GetPos() ) -- Put the position of the explosion at the position of the entity explosion:Spawn() -- Spawn the explosion explosion:SetKeyValue( "iMagnitude", "50" ) -- the magnitude of the explosion explosion:Fire( "Explode", 0, 0 ) -- explode end

arguments.name: fullUpdate
arguments.description:
Whether the removal is happening due to a full update clientside.

The entity may or **may not** be recreated immediately after, depending on whether it is in the local player's [PVS](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/PVS "PVS - Valve Developer Community"). (See <page>Entity:IsDormant</page>)

functions.name: OnRestore
functions.description:
Called when the entity is reloaded from a Source Engine save (not the Sandbox saves or dupes) or on a changelevel (for example Half-Life 2 campaign level transitions).

For the <page>duplicator</page> callbacks, see <page>ENTITY:OnDuplicated</page>.

functions.name: OnStateChange
functions.description:
Called by the engine when NPC's state changes.

<note>This hook only exists for `ai` type SENTs.</note>

arguments.name: oldState
arguments.description: The old state. See <page>Enums/NPC_STATE</page>.

arguments.name: newState
arguments.description: The new state. See <page>Enums/NPC_STATE</page>.

functions.name: OnTakeDamage
functions.description:
Called when the entity is taking damage.

<warning>Calling <page>Entity:TakeDamage</page>, <page>Entity:TakeDamageInfo</page>, <page>Entity:DispatchTraceAttack</page>, or <page>Player:TraceHullAttack</page> (if the entity is hit) in this hook on the victim entity can cause infinite loops since the hook will be called again. Make sure to setup recursion safeguards like the example below.</warning>

<note>This hook is only called for `ai`, `nextbot` and `anim` type entities.</note>

arguments.name: damage
arguments.description: The damage to be applied to the entity.

returnValues.description: How much damage the entity took. Basically `> 0` means took damage, `0` means did not take damage.

functions.name: OnTaskComplete
functions.description:
Called from the engine when TaskComplete is called.
This allows us to move onto the next task - even when TaskComplete was called from an engine side task.

<note>This hook only exists for `ai` type [SENTs](Scripted_Entities).</note>

functions.name: OnTaskFailed
functions.description:
Called when a task this NPC was running has failed for whatever reason.
<note>This hook only exists for `ai` type [SENTs](Scripted_Entities).</note>

arguments.name: failCode
arguments.description: The fail code for the task. It will be a [FAIL_ enum](https://github.com/ValveSoftware/source-sdk-2013/blob/0d8dceea4310fde5706b3ce1c70609d72a38efdf/sp/src/game/server/ai_task.h#L26) or a generated code for a custom string. (second argument)

arguments.name: failReason
arguments.description: If set, a custom reason for the failure.

functions.name: OnTraceAttack
functions.description:
Called when a trace attack is done against the entity, allowing override of the damage being dealt by altering the <page>CTakeDamageInfo</page>.

This is called before <page>ENTITY:OnTakeDamage</page>.
<note>This hook is only called for `ai`, `anim` (as of version `2026.07.03`) and `nextbot` type entities.</note>

arguments.name: info
arguments.description: The damage info

arguments.name: dir
arguments.description: The direction the damage goes in

arguments.name: trace
arguments.description: The <page>Structures/TraceResult</page> of the attack, containing the hitgroup.

functions.name: OverrideMove
functions.description:
Called to completely override NPC movement. This can be used for example for flying NPCs.

<note>This hook only exists for `ai` type SENTs.</note>

arguments.name: interval
arguments.description: Time interval for the movement, in seconds. Usually time since last movement.

returnValues.description: Return `true` to disable the default movement code.

functions.name: OverrideMoveFacing
functions.description:
Called to completely override the direction NPC will be facing during navigation.

<note>This hook only exists for `ai` type SENTs.</note>
<note>This hook is called by the default movement hook. Returning `true` inside <page>ENTITY:OverrideMove</page> will prevent engine from calling this hook. </note>

arguments.name: interval
arguments.description: Time interval for the movement, in seconds. Usually time since last movement.

arguments.name: AILMG
arguments.description:
Extra data for the movement. A table containing the following data:
* <page>boolean</page> hasTraced - The result if a forward probing trace has been done
* <page>number</page> expectedDist = `speed*interval` - The distance expected to move this think
* <page>number</page> flags - [AILMG flags](https://github.com/ValveSoftware/source-sdk-2013/blob/master/src/game/server/ai_movetypes.h#L113)
* <page>number</page> maxDist = <page>NPC:GetPathDistanceToGoal</page> - The distance maximum distance intended to travel in path length
* <page>number</page> navType - <page>Enums/NAV</page>
* <page>number</page> speed - <page>Entity:GetSequenceGroundSpeed</page> Note these need not always agree with `target`
* <page>Entity</page> moveTarget = `m_hGoalEnt` - Target entity as goal.
* <page>Vector</page> dir - The step direction, towards `target`
* <page>Vector</page> facing - The direction NPC's body will turn during movement.
* <page>Vector</page> target = <page>NPC:GetCurWaypointPos</page> - Current waypoint in world coordinates.

returnValues.description: Return `true` to disable the default movement facing code.

functions.name: PassesTriggerFilters
functions.description:
Polls whenever the entity should trigger the brush.

<warning>This hook is broken and will not work without code below</warning>

arguments.name: ent
arguments.description: The entity that is about to trigger.

returnValues.description: Should trigger or not.

functions.name: PhysicsCollide
functions.description:
Called when the entity collides with anything via [physics objects](PhysObj). The [move type](Enums/MOVETYPE) and [solid mode](Enums/SOLID) must be `VPHYSICS` for the hook to be called.
This hook only works for `anim` type entities.

This is different from <page>ENTITY:Touch</page>.

<note>If you want to use this hook on default/engine/non-Lua entities (like `prop_physics`), use <page>Entity:AddCallback</page> instead! This page describes a hook for Lua scripted entities</note>

arguments.name: colData
arguments.description: Information regarding the collision. See <page>Structures/CollisionData</page>.

arguments.name: collider
arguments.description: The physics object that collided.

functions.name: PhysicsSimulate
functions.description:
Called from the Entity's motion controller to simulate physics.

This will only be called after using <page>Entity:StartMotionController</page> on a <page text="scripted entity">Scripted_Entities</page> of `anim` type.

<note>This hook can work on the CLIENT if you call <page>Entity:StartMotionController</page> and use <page>Entity:AddToMotionController</page> on the physics objects you want to control</note>

<warning>Do not use functions such as <page>PhysObj:EnableCollisions</page> or <page>PhysObj:EnableGravity</page> in this hook as they're very likely to crash your game. You may want to use <page>ENTITY:PhysicsUpdate</page> instead.</warning>

arguments.name: phys
arguments.description: The physics object of the entity.

arguments.name: deltaTime
arguments.description: Time since the last call.

returnValues.description: Angular force. The 3rd argument must be above SIM_NOTHING.
Linear force. The 3rd argument must be above SIM_NOTHING.
One of the <page>Enums/SIM</page>.

functions.name: PhysicsUpdate
functions.description:
Called whenever a physics object of this entity is updated.

This hook won't be called if the Entity's <page>PhysObj</page> goes asleep, or doesn't exist.

arguments.name: phys
arguments.description: The physics object of the entity.

functions.name: PostEntityCopy

functions.name: TestCollision
functions.description:
Allows you to override trace result when a trace hits the entity.

Your entity **must** have <page>Entity:EnableCustomCollisions</page> enabled for this hook to work.

Your entity must also be otherwise "hit-able" with a trace, so it should have <page text="SOLID_OBB">Enums/SOLID#SOLID_OBB</page> or <page text="SOLID_VPHYSICS">Enums/SOLID#SOLID_VPHYSICS</page> be set (as an example), and it must have its <page text="collision bounds">Entity:SetCollisionBounds</page> be set accordingly.

<note>This hook is called for `anim` type only.</note>

arguments.name: startpos
arguments.description: Start position of the trace.

arguments.name: delta
arguments.description: Offset from startpos to the endpos of the trace.

arguments.name: isbox
arguments.description: Is the trace a hull trace?

arguments.name: extents
arguments.description: Size of the hull trace, with the center of the Bounding Box being `0, 0, 0`, so mins are `-extents`, and maxs are `extents`.

arguments.name: mask
arguments.description: The <page>Enums/CONTENTS</page> mask.

returnValues.description:
Returning a `table` will allow you to override trace results. Table should contain the following keys: (All keys fallback to the original trace value) * Vector `HitPos` - The new hit position of the trace. * number `Fraction` - A number from `0` to `1`, describing how far the trace went from its origin point, `1` = did not hit. * Could be calculated like so : `Fraction = ( startpos + delta ):Length() / myCustomHitPos:Length()` * Vector `Normal` - A unit vector (length=1) describing the direction perpendicular to the hit surface. Returning `true` will allow "normal" collisions to happen for `SOLID_VPHYSICS` and `SOLID_OBB` entities.
Returning `nothing` or `false` allows the trace to ignore the entity completely.

functions.name: PlayerInitialSpawn
functions.description:
Called when the player spawns for the first time.

See <page>GM:PlayerSpawn</page> for a hook called every player spawn.

<note>This hook is called before the player has fully loaded, when the player is still in seeing the `Starting Lua` screen. For example, trying to use the <page>Entity:GetModel</page> function will return the default model (`models/player.mdl`).</note>

<warning> Sending <page>net</page> messages to the spawned player in this hook may cause them to be received before the player finishes loading, for example <page>Global.LocalPlayer</page> might return NULL since <page>GM:InitPostEntity</page> may have not been called yet clientside though the net message **won't** be lost and the client still should receive it (more information here: https://github.com/Facepunch/garrysmod-requests/issues/718).

Workaround without networking:
```
local load_queue = {}

hook.Add( "PlayerInitialSpawn", "myAddonName/Load", function( ply )
load_queue[ ply ] = true
end )

hook.Add( "StartCommand", "myAddonName/Load", function( ply, cmd )
if load_queue[ ply ] and not cmd:IsForced() then
load_queue[ ply ] = nil

-- Send what you need here if it requires the client to be fully loaded!
end
end )
```


With networking:
```
-- CLIENT
hook.Add( "InitPostEntity", "Ready", function()
net.Start( "cool_addon_client_ready" )
net.SendToServer()
end )
```
```
-- SERVER
util.AddNetworkString( "cool_addon_client_ready" )

net.Receive( "cool_addon_client_ready", function( len, ply )
-- Send what you need here!
end )
```
</warning>

functions.name: PerformLayout
functions.description:
Called whenever the panels' layout needs to be performed again. This means all child panels must be re-positioned to fit the possibly new size of this panel.

This can be triggered in numerous ways:
* <page>Panel:InvalidateLayout</page> was called this or previous frame (depending on the argument)
* <page>Panel:SetPos</page> called more than once on the same panel ([Issue](https://github.com/Facepunch/garrysmod-issues/issues/5519))
* A child element was added to this panel (TODO: Verify me)
* The size of this panel has changed

You should not call this function directly. Use <page>Panel:InvalidateLayout</page> instead.

You should also be careful to not cause layout loops. You can use `vgui_visualizelayout 1` to visualize panel layouts as they happen for debugging purposes. Panels should not be doing this every frame for performance reasons.

arguments.name: width
arguments.description: The panels current width.
